## Windows validation / Windows 验证

- [ ] Ran the relevant install, start, verify, apply, or restore path
- [ ] Ran `windows/tests/run-tests.ps1`
- [ ] Built the WinUI manager in Release mode when applicable
- [ ] Recorded the Windows and Codex versions used for live validation
- [ ] Updated `DEVELOPMENT_PROGRESS.md` and `DEVELOPMENT_LOG.md`
- [ ] Updated `CHANGELOG.md` for a user-visible release change

## Safety / 安全

- [ ] Does not modify Codex binaries, `WindowsApps`, `app.asar`, or signatures
- [ ] Does not write API Base URLs, API keys, authentication files, or account data
- [ ] Keeps CDP bound to `127.0.0.1`
- [ ] Revalidates package/process identity before guarded takeover or close operations
- [ ] Includes no screenshots or logs with private account, chat, project, or path data
